## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The change is scoped to one logical unit (one feature/fix per branch)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behavior; coverage does not decrease
- [ ] Linting, formatting, and type checks pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated (docs/, READMEs, OpenAPI/event schemas) where affected
- [ ] No cross-domain dependencies, hard-coded providers, or global state introduced
- [ ] Architectural changes are covered by an accepted ADR
